snippet.title: Avalon: Rise of The Templars and The Druids | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
The Unreal Engine 4 and 5  game with cutting-edge graphics is officially here. 

Enjoy the incredible footage from our pre-alpha gameplay. 

Purchase your pre-release pass below!

Follow us for the latest updates :
https://linktr.ee/avalonthegame


Avalon is an online multiplayer role-playing game (MMO) built in Unreal Engine . Set in a fantasy medieval kingdom, players utilize their Characters to explore a world of danger and mystery while competing for cryptocurrency and rare in game rewards. The game is built around both active play-to-earn and passive own-to-earn economies.

Inspired by the legend of King Arthur and the Island of Avalon, this game challenges every player to undertake a thrilling adventure in their quest to ultimately claim their very own seat among the Knights of The Round Table. Along the way, players earn rewards (AVL tokens) by purchasing, renting, or securing resources as well as collaborating with  landowners to acquire and build in-game real estate.

#mmo #mmorpg
